spans.s: देह m.n. The body, R.i.13, K.S.i.21, Rt.iv.15.
देह-अंतर n. another body.
देह-अंतर˚प्राप्ति f. transmigration.
देह-आत्मवाद m. materialism, especially that of Chārvāka, स्वप्नदृशोऽवगत्यबाधनेन देहमात्रात्मवादो दूषितां वेदितव्यः S.Bh.ii.1.
देह-आत्मवादिन् m. a materialist, a Chārvāka.
देह-आवरण n. armour, dress.
देह-ईश्वर m. the soul.
देह-उद्भव, -उद्भूत a. born in the body, innate.
देह-उद्भव, -उद्भूत a. born in the body, innate.
देह-कर्तृ m. 1. the sun; 2. the supreme soul.
देह-कोष m. the covering of the body, i.e. a feather, wing &c.
देह-क्षय m. 1. sickness, disease; 2. decay of the body.
देह-गत a. incarnate, embodied.
देह-ज m. a son.
देह-जा f. a daughter.
देह-त्याग m. 1. death in general; 2. voluntary death, तीर्थे तोयव्यतिकरभवे जह्नुकन्यासरय्वोर्देहत्यागात् R.viii.95.
देह-द m. quick-silver.
देह-दीप m. the eye.
देह-धर्म m. the function of the body.
देह-धारक n. a bone.
देह-धारण n. living, life.
देह-धि m. wing.
देह-धृष् m. air, wind.
देहंभर a. gluttonous.
देह-भाज् m. any being possessed of a body, especially a man.
देह-भुज् m. 1. the soul; 2. the sun.
देह-भृत् m. 1. a living being, especially a man, धिगिमां देहभृतामसारताम् R.viii.51, Bg.viii.4; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. life, vitality.
देह-यात्रा f. 1. dying, death; 2. nourishment, food.
देह-लक्षण n. a mole, a dark spot under the skin.
देह-वत् m. 1. man; 2. the soul.
देह-वायु m. a vital air; (they are five, See अपान).
देह-सार m. marrow.
देह-स्वभाव m. bodily temperament.
देहला f. Spirituous liquor.
देहलि m. The threshold of a door, the lower part of the wooden frame of a door, विन्यस्यंती भुवि गणनया देहलीदत्तपुष्पैः Megh.i.24, याप्तां बलिः सपदि मद्गृहदेहलीनाम् Mrich.i.
देहली f. The threshold of a door, the lower part of the wooden frame of a door, विन्यस्यंती भुवि गणनया देहलीदत्तपुष्पैः Megh.i.24, याप्तां बलिः सपदि मद्गृहदेहलीनाम् Mrich.i.
देहली-दीप m. a lamp hung over the threshold.

देहली-दीप˚न्याय m. the maxim of the lamp, hung over the threshold. The maxim takes its origin from such a lamp lighting the rooms on either side of the threshold, and is applied to indicate something serviceable in a double capacity.
देहिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Incarnate, embodied.
देहिन् (II) m. 1. A living being, especially a man, देहिनस्तद्वरं रजः Sis.ii.46, Bg.ii.13; 2. the soul, तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णान्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही Bg.ii.22.
देहिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Incarnate, embodied.
देहिनी f. The earth.
